title: Snake in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='snakeBody' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#5ee86b'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2fbf4a'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- Coiled body -->
  <path d="M28 82 Q18 82 18 72 Q18 62 30 62 Q46 62 46 50 Q46 38 34 38 Q22 38 22 48 Q22 56 32 56 Q42 56 42 48"
        fill='none' stroke='url(#snakeBody)' stroke-width='11' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Body scale highlights -->
  <path d="M28 82 Q18 82 18 72 Q18 62 30 62 Q46 62 46 50 Q46 38 34 38 Q22 38 22 48 Q22 56 32 56 Q42 56 42 48"
        fill='none' stroke='#9ef7a8' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Neck rising up -->
  <path d="M42 48 Q42 34 54 30 L62 27" fill='none' stroke='#48d65e' stroke-width='10' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <ellipse cx='68' cy='25' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#5ee86b'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='25' rx='13' ry='9' fill='none' stroke='#9ef7a8' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <ellipse cx='78' cy='27' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#8ff59b'/>

  <circle cx='66' cy='21' r='2.6' fill='#1be0d0'/>

  <circle cx='66.8' cy='20.2' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='73.8' cy='20.2' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Nostrils -->
  <circle cx='80' cy='26' r='0.7' fill='#1b8f3a'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='29' r='0.7' fill='#1b8f3a'/>
  <!-- Tongue -->
  <path d="M83 31 L89 34 M89 34 L92 32 M89 34 L92 37" fill='none' stroke='#ff5c8a' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Scarf wrapped around neck -->
  <path d="M50 39 Q58 33 66 36 Q70 37 68 43 Q60 47 52 45 Q48 44 50 39 Z" fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <path d="M50 39 Q58 33 66 36 Q70 37 68 43 Q60 47 52 45 Q48 44 50 39 Z" fill='none' stroke='#ff9db0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Scarf stripes -->
  <path d="M55 37 Q57 40 55 44" fill='none' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='2'/>
  <path d="M61 35 Q63 39 61 43" fill='none' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Scarf tail hanging -->
  <path d="M63 42 Q64 52 60 58 Q57 62 61 60 Q66 54 65 44 Z" fill='#e0335a'/>
  <path d="M63 42 Q64 52 60 58 Q57 62 61 60 Q66 54 65 44 Z" fill='none' stroke='#ff9db0' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <path d="M63 47 Q63 51 61 55" fill='none' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='1.8'/>
  <!-- Scarf fringe -->
  <path d="M59 60 L58 64 M61 60 L61 65 M63 59 L64 64" fill='none' stroke='#ff4d6d' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
